text:
PagerBot: PAGING — KV cache slab leak detected on kv-prod-eu-1. Memory growth ~30% over 10m on continuous-batching workers. Severity: critical. Alert: https://monitoring.redwood.example/alerts/1918001234
Alex Cheng: I'm oncall, investigating. @Meera can you grab allocator logs from kv-prod-eu-1? tagging @InfraOncall as well.
Meera Patel: grabbing logs now, tailing /var/log/kv-allocator.log. Seeing repeated `pytorch::cudaMalloc` failures + arena fragmentation warnings. snippet:
```
ERROR AllocatorArena: fragmentation_ratio=0.82
ERROR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
```
Tomas Brun: looks like continuous-batching spike is creating a lot of small allocations that never compact. Immediate mitigation: reduce continuous batch window and cap max_batch_tokens. Recommend: continuous_batch_window_ms=5, max_batch_tokens=512. Canary to 10% first.
Alex Cheng: agreed. initiating hotfix: `rbxctl set-config kv-prod-eu-1 --continuous_batch_window_ms=5 --max_batch_tokens=512 --rollout=canary=10%` executing now.
PagerBot: Deploy job 1918001234-ht started by Alex Cheng — status: running.
Meera Patel: also kicking off targeted eviction for largest prefixes to free slab pressure: `python ops/evict_kv_prefix.py --pool kv-prod-eu-1 --prefix session:` — running against canary hosts.
Sylvia Ng: observability note — embeddings route latency + error spike. ~12 customers in EU reported 502/504s in last 8m. No signs of data leakage. CS notified top 5 affected customers.
Alex Cheng: canary results: memory trend on canary hosts stabilized within 4m. Rolling to 50% now. Patch output:
```
rollout: canary 10% -> 50%
apply: OK on 3 hosts
```
Tomas Brun: allocator logs show fragmentation decreasing but some slabs still not freed; suggests compaction not triggering. Recommend setting env `ARENA_COMPACT=1` on remaining hosts and doing a controlled restart of allocator workers in small waves.
Meera Patel: doing wave restarts. `systemctl restart kv-allocator` on two hosts at a time to avoid capacity cliffs. Starting wave 1.
InfraOncall: coordinating restarts and healthchecks. I'll keep Nginx health checks in watch. Creating incident ticket for postmortem: https://tickets.redwood.example/INC-1918001234
Alex Cheng: customer impact summary: EU embeddings customers saw transient 5–10m errors. Estimated ~0.2% of total requests affected. We'll mark incident as mitigating for now. No SLA breach expected but monitoring closely.
PagerBot: Incident status changed to "mitigating" by Alex Cheng.
Meera Patel: after restarts + ARENA_COMPACT=1, `cudaMalloc` errors stopped in logs. Leaving KV_ARENA_COMPACT=1 for 24h and will re-evaluate fragmentation metrics.
Sylvia Ng: CS update: customers cust-834, cust-902, cust-1101 notified with a summary and ETA ~4h for full stabilization.
Alex Cheng: prepping handoff in 2h. Remaining actions: collect slab histograms, run fragmentation compaction job overnight, create RFC for allocator tuning. @InfraOncall please create RFC and link.
InfraOncall: RFC created: https://docs.redwood.example/rfcs/arena-tuning-191800 — also adding runbook updates and reminder for blameless postmortem. @Tomas please own allocator perf testing.
Tomas Brun: I'll run synthetic workloads across batch_window [5,10,20ms] and token caps [512,1024] and gather KV slab histograms + latency profiles. Will post results to the ticket.
Alex Cheng: thanks all. final note: do not rollback batch config until we have slab histograms and compaction metrics. I'll update the channel when incident is resolved. :thumbsup:
